newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on speculative trade.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Thursday, mainly on speculative activity, but early gains were slightly trimmed on position-squaring ahead of Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.

Dealer Owais Anis said the day's key attractions were Dewan Salman Fibres and ICI Pakistan, which rose on speculative buying. "There was also buying in other select scrips, but gains were restricted because of position-squaring ahead of weekend."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 6.88 points, or 0.48 percent, to end at 1,451.37 amid 158 gainers and 87 losers. Dewan Salman rose 0.55 rupees to 35.30. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
